linkedin.headline: Product manager | Marlowe Freight Software
linkedin.about: I manage a product that helps small hauliers plan routes. I am thoughtful, a good listener, and I prefer a calm pace and a clear plan ahead. I need quiet time to recharge after busy weeks, usually at my pottery wheel. I am looking for someone who enjoys slow Sundays and cosy evenings in.

experience.title: Product Manager
experience.description: Own the routing roadmap and weekly releases for a team of six.

experience.title: Business Analyst
experience.description: Wrote requirements and tested workflows with customers.

instagram.bio: Pottery, filter coffee and the occasional quiet night in.

posts.caption: Wheel-thrown bowls out of the kiln today. Ceramics is patience made visible.
Slow Sunday: coffee, a record on, nowhere to be. Cosy is underrated.
Glaze test tiles. Some work, some are a disaster, all taught me something.
Staying in tonight with a novel and a very large mug.
